facts.statement: The sample design of the Periodic Labour Force Survey was revamped from January 2025.
facts.subject: Periodic Labour Force Survey
facts.evidence_quote: The sample design of the Periodic Labour Force Survey was revamped from January 2025

facts.statement: The timeliness of the quick estimate of the industrial production index improved to 28 days after the reference month with the release of the March 2025 data.
facts.subject: quick estimate of the industrial production index
facts.evidence_quote: With the release of the March 2025 data (in April 2025), the timeliness of the quick estimate of the industrial production index improved from six weeks to 28 days after the reference month.

facts.statement: The timeliness of the Balance of Payments data improved to 60 days after the reference quarter with the release of the April-June 2025/26 data.
facts.subject: Balance of Payments data
facts.evidence_quote: The timeliness of the Balance of Payments data improved from around 90 to 60 days after the reference quarter with the release of the April-June 2025/26 data (in September 2025).

facts.statement: The planned publication date for the updated national accounts and CPI series is in early 2026.
facts.subject: updated national accounts and CPI series
facts.evidence_quote: Work to update the national accounts and CPI series is ongoing, with a planned publication date in early 2026.

facts.statement: India has subscribed to the Special Data Dissemination Standard (SDDS) since December 1996.
facts.subject: India
facts.predicate: subscription date to the Special Data Dissemination Standard (SDDS)
facts.evidence_quote: India subscribes to the Special Data Dissemination Standard (SDDS) since December 1996

facts.statement: The Population Census was last conducted in 2011.
facts.subject: Population Census
facts.evidence_quote: Priority should be considered for the Population Census, last conducted in 2011.

facts.statement: The table of common indicators required for surveillance is as of September 30, 2025.
facts.subject: Table of Common Indicators Required for Surveillance
